console.footer.tagline: Storage and management interface for Meshtastic-based sensor networks. Built by Sensical SCCL in Barcelona.
page.home.hero.title: The world's first <accent>storage and data solution for Meshtastic sensors</accent>
page.home.hero.subtitle: Collect sensor data with <highlight>Meshtastic based sensor networks.</highlight> Deploy locally or on the cloud.
page.home.cta.title: Contact us for deployment options
page.home.cta.subtitle: Feel free to check the demo, and reach out to us with any questions.
page.home.footer.tagline: Storage and a console for Meshtastic networks. Built by Sensical SCCL in Barcelona.
page.home.faq.heading: Frequently asked <secondary>questions</secondary>
page.home.faq.meshtastic.a: A storage and data layer for Meshtastic networks and telemetry data. The data comes from MQQT and gets stored and processed in Mesh Things. Mesh Things can be deployed locally on a Raspberry Pi or on a cloud server.
page.home.faq.federated.q: Can data be shared across instances?
page.home.faq.federated.a: Yes, you can keep data local or send it to a cloud server.
page.home.faq.globe.a: Yes, we are working on releasing the platform and it's front-end application. Stay tuned for more news, and feel free to contact us for more information.
page.home.faq.signIn.a: Anyone can register an owner account in the demo server. Storage of data in the demo server is not guaranteed yet. Feel free to contact us for more information and deployment options.
page.home.extras.heading: Choose your deployment type. <secondary>For your sensors and your platform.</secondary>
page.home.extras.storage.title: Storage for the mesh
page.home.extras.storage.body: Timeseries storage for Meshtastic-based sensor networks.
page.home.extras.gateways.title: Choose the data publishers
page.home.extras.gateways.body: A registered gateway allows data ingestion. Disallow it and that traffic stops being stored.

page.home.extras.channels.body: Check latest values and historic readings.

page.home.extras.operators.body: Deployment is simple, and data is easily accessible.

page.home.extras.position.title: Location as an option
page.home.extras.position.body: Store location packets directly or choose to keep location private.
page.home.extras.blueprints.title: Data processing
page.home.extras.blueprints.body: Attach post-processing to a device when the raw channel needs algorithms.
page.home.extras.noBanner.title: Trigger alarms
page.home.extras.noBanner.body: Trigger alarms for sensor data in real time to any devices.
page.home.extras.lora.title: Access your data
page.home.extras.lora.body: REST API available as well as S3 bucket storage.

page.terms.title: Terms and Conditions
page.terms.acceptance.heading: Acceptance of these terms
page.terms.acceptance.body: By creating an owner account you agree to these terms and to our handling of your data as described below.
page.terms.use.heading: Use of the service
page.terms.use.body: Meshtastic Things is a storage and console layer for Meshtastic networks. You are responsible for the meshes, devices and data you register under your account.
page.terms.accounts.heading: Accounts and email verification
page.terms.accounts.body: A new account stays inactive until you confirm the email address you registered with. You are responsible for keeping your password and API keys confidential.
page.terms.data.heading: Data
page.terms.data.body: Telemetry and configuration you submit is stored to operate the service and is not sold to third parties.
page.terms.termination.heading: Termination
page.terms.termination.body: You may delete your account at any time from the console. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
page.terms.changes.heading: Changes to these terms
page.terms.changes.body: We may update these terms as the product evolves. Continued use of the service after a change constitutes acceptance.
page.terms.contact.heading: Contact
page.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to Sensical SCCL through the contact page linked in the footer.
